stem: Which sentence should replace sentence 7 to more clearly state the central idea of this paper?

options.label: A
options.text: This person walked the streets and shouted out information the people needed to know.

options.label: B
options.text: This person lived in the town, and everyone recognized him right away.

options.label: C
options.text: This person sometimes spent the day visiting people in different parts of the village.

options.label: D
options.text: This person was kind and respected, and most people in the town liked him.
